judgment.explanation: Event-001 already supplies inline receipt WH-035 confirming receipt of RT-035 for TG-035 and explicitly distinguishes warehouse receiving from refund approval. In event-002, the customer asks for that receipt to be passed to the team handling refund review. The proposal is clear and makes no unauthorized commitment, but it unnecessarily asks the customer to supply evidence already visible and asserts an unsupported upload prerequisite. The appropriate next step is internal routing of the existing receipt for refund review, or internal clarification of the responsible team if unknown.
